saints.name: St. Chromatius of Aquileia
saints.title: Bishop of Aquileia
saints.shortBlurb: The bishop of Aquileia and biblical commentator who befriended Jerome and worked as a craftsman of peace in a troubled age…
biography: Chromatius became bishop of Aquileia in northern Italy about the year 388 and made his city a center of learning and orthodoxy. A friend and patron of St. Jerome, he encouraged and helped support Jerome's biblical labors, and he sought to reconcile Jerome with their mutual friend Rufinus when the two were divided over the writings of Origen.

He left commentaries on the Gospel of Matthew and homilies still valued today, and he consoled and defended his people amid the disorders that came with the invasion of Italy by Alaric. He died about the year 407.
saints.knownFor: Bishop of Aquileia, biblical commentator, and friend of St. Jerome.
